scope: Read-only source review of target fidelity, checkpoint/metric callback state and information boundaries; no additional training experiments.

findings.status: resolved by evaluator owner before campaign evaluation
findings.detail: Initial evaluator checked design/prior identity without checking the conditioned observation vector or declared synthetic case identity.
findings.resolution: Evaluator now requires expected observations and reference kind; rejects synthetic references for the market call; binds synthetic index/id/truth/errors, run/case observations, float64 hashes and deterministic observation recomposition. A CLI-only bootstrap import failure was subsequently fixed before loading any checkpoint; failed launch attempts remain preserved.
findings.validation: Independent rerun: all nine evaluator tests pass, including real direct-CLI bootstrap, observation identity, reserved-test isolation and float32 support handling.

findings.detail: Under BayesFlow 2.1 JAXEstimator.stateless_train_step, callback logs[loss] is the current batch loss, not a cumulative average.
findings.interpretation: Label this field as batch loss in analysis. Fixed train_probe_loss and validation_probe_loss remain valid for evaluating the train/validation gap.

findings.status: nonblocking future producer/reanalysis hardening; existing producer preserved unchanged
findings.detail: The emitted current cases are internally consistent. Future load/reanalysis should explicitly bind panel names and c=1 plus supplied design, bounds, and config/case observation hashes.
findings.resolution: All six current cases are exactly bound by the evaluator and independent numerical auditor. Producer commit76cef0d and original diagnostics remain immutable; additional guards within the old producer are deferred rather than duplicated.

target_review.physical_prior: Independent physical Uniform draws for five Heston parameters; kappa<=10 and xi<=3.
target_review.nuisance_prior: Fresh independent tau~Uniform(0,.02), c~Uniform(.5,2) and Gaussian errors per row and optimizer step.
target_review.observation_law: Untruncated Gaussian, SD hypot(c*halfspread,tau*frozen_market_vega); design/carry/vegas remain frozen.
target_review.conditioning: Observed quote values and spread metadata only; true tau stays exclusively in posterior targets.

jax_callback_review.synchronization: Keras Callback.model synchronizes attached JAX state before callback access; fit reloads synchronized state for the next step.
jax_callback_review.probes: BayesFlow compute_metrics(stage=validation) leaves standardization moments unchanged; spline validation computes deterministic density loss without updating training RNG.
jax_callback_review.checkpoints: Saving/loading creates a separate estimator; diagnostic sampling uses explicit seeds and verifies exact same-seed reload samples.
jax_callback_review.assessment: No callback interference with gradient/optimizer state identified by source review.

information_boundary_review.training: Existing bank loads only train_ and validation_ members; fresh bank generation returns only those members to training.
information_boundary_review.evaluation: Development evaluator requests only validation_parameters, validation_clean and validation_row_id; reserved test members remain unopened.
information_boundary_review.selection: Development validation and declared conditional cases may guide the bounded matrix; final reserved acceptance cases remain separate.

limits: Source review is not an empirical claim that every callback path has been exercised.
Probe losses use the current standardized transformed-target coordinates; no physical-coordinate density interpretation is asserted.
Numerical reference precision and MCMC convergence are audited separately.

underlying_model_provenance.run_record_limitation: Synthetic producer run records hash pilot.py but omit its imported tutorial Heston model file.
underlying_model_provenance.assessment: No current model-source drift identified; future producers can record this dependency directly.

independent_review: Data-audit agent read the new numerical audit binding/likelihood code and identified no observation or likelihood bug.

summary_review.scope: Read-only comparison against all four emitted evaluation JSON files.
summary_review.extraction: Parameter means, width ratios, Monte Carlo intervals and 90% coverage extraction match actual schema.
summary_review.support_extraction: Root corrected the initially omitted actual neural_support field and preserves numeric_support_boundary_draw_count.
summary_review.paired_observation_guard: Root now verifies draws.npz SHA and binds actual validation truth and observation float64 hashes, evaluation seed and evaluator source across all four cells. Current task/cohort/seed/cases were independently checked against emitted JSON files.
summary_review.claims: Current scope correctly states one seed, fixed task and development evidence only; it does not establish capacity effects, fresh acceptance or market-model adequacy.
summary_review.actual_results: All four market comparisons and all six completed synthetic conditional comparisons per cell fail their declared agreement criteria; approximate prior-predictive coverage near90% does not contradict those conditional failures.
